summary_en: This study is testing IDP-001, a drug given to people with advanced or metastatic squamous and non-squamous lung cancer and other squamous cell solid tumors. IDP-001 is given as an intravenous (IV) infusion, and how often and for how long are not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body (pharmacokinetics), and early signs of antitumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa IDP-001, un medicamento que se administra a personas con cáncer de pulmón avanzado o metastásico, de tipo escamoso y no escamoso, y otros tumores sólidos de células escamosas. IDP-001 se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV), y no se indica con qué frecuencia ni durante cuánto tiempo. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo se distribuye el medicamento en el cuerpo (farmacocinética) y las primeras señales de actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 to 1
Histologically confirmed advanced, metastatic, or recurrent solid tumor not amenable to surgery or other approved therapy
not_for: Active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV, or uncontrolled infection needing IV treatment
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis requiring systemic steroids
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
